labels: The student's forehead rests on crossed forearms on the desktop, leaving the chair back and both lower legs visible below the desk.; 학생의 이마가 책상 위 교차한 아래팔에 놓이고 책상 아래로 의자 등받이와 두 종아리가 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The student's forehead rests on crossed forearms on the desktop, leaving the chair back and both lower legs visible below the desk.
aliases: 엎드림과 머리 받침
